AAFA.SettingsRequireTargetHint: Require a selected target to play the animation. If disabled and no target is selected, the attacker will be used as the target.
AAFA.SettingsOnlyDuringCombatHint: Limit animation execution to turn in active combat.
AAFA.SettingsCheckItemHint: If enabled, the animation only triggers if the actor owns an item whose name matches. If disabled, any matching will trigger. (disable it for non-item Skills)
AAFA.SettingsEnableEquipMacroHint: Allows sending a chat message based on equipped item data path via macro. (for systems that don't trigger attack messages with the item name automatically).
AAFA.SettingsEquipItemPathHint: Path in the actor's data where the equipped item is stored. Example: system.equipment.weapon
AAFA.SettingsEquipMessageTemplateHint: Message to send. Variables: {attacker}, {target}, {item}. {item} is mandatory.
AAFA.SettingsAnonymousNameHint: Text to use when a token's name is hidden.
AAFA.LogNoItemMatch: No matching item found in actor.
AAFA.ItemNotFound: No item found at the specified path.
AAFA.MacroOff: Equip Macro is disabled. Enable it in settings to use this macro.
